create_pipeline_stable_diffusion_xl_ipex: create a Stable Diffusion XL pipeline optimized for Intel CPUs using IPEX
run_prepare_for_ipex: run prepare_for_ipex to optimize UNet, VAE decoder, and text encoder with IPEX and JIT tracing
run_pipeline_call: run the pipeline __call__ method to generate images from text prompts with classifier-free guidance
run_encode_prompt: run encode_prompt to convert text prompts into token embeddings for the text encoders
run_rescale_noise_cfg: run rescale_noise_cfg to rescale guidance noise and fix overexposure in generated images
